en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a street corner with a large multi‑story hotel building. The façade bears painted signs reading "ALBERGO S. MARCO" and "LUIGI GREGORI." People sit at café tables under small trees, while others stand at the entrance; several horse‑drawn carriages wait along the street lined with tall shuttered buildings. At the top of the postcard, printed in red, is the title indicating the hotel's name and the city of Trento.
